text:
ella: Quick Q — corporate card was declined on Lyon->Paris TER yesterday. Ended up paying with my personal card €72.30. Conductor said no paper receipt available, only a short email confirmation with a transaction/ref number. What do I upload for reimbursement? cc @finance-team :wave:
sam.f: sorry for the hassle — we can reimburse this. We need (1) proof of payment (bank/card screenshot) showing the €72.30 charge, (2) the conductor email or any vendor confirmation, and (3) a short note explaining 'card declined, paid with personal card'. If you upload those to Expensify it's fine. For foreign txns we convert to USD at the merchant date rate. :thumbsup:
ella: I have a bank screenshot and the conductor email (says "no paper receipt, ref 12345"). I'll upload now. Do you want the exact USD conversion in the notes or do you handle it?
sam.f: upload both attachments and leave the currency as EUR in Expensify. In the notes add the conversion we show on the bank (if available) otherwise leave blank and we will apply the official conversion. Note: our policy 3.2 says expenses > $75 require manager approval — the EUR amount is ~€72.30 which is roughly $79, so this will need a quick approval. Tag the expense with "TRAIN-EMERGENCY" so I can see it.
ella: uploaded: screenshot.png and conductor-email.pdf, expense created and tagged TRAIN-EMERGENCY. Added note: "card declined, paid personal. ref 12345."
expense-bot: New expense submitted by ella — amount: 72.30 EUR, tags: TRAIN-EMERGENCY, status: awaiting approval. Expense ID: EXP-2024-8872.
michael: approved — fine to reimburse, manager sign-off here. :white_check_mark:
sam.f: Thanks michael — I'll fast-track the reimbursement on this one. Ella, expect reimbursement on next payroll run unless you want an expedited ACH (can do same-day, let me know). Also added internal memo that VAT stub wasn't available.
ella: same-day ACH would be great if possible, thanks so much. :pray:
sam.f: noted — expensed and pushed for same-day ACH. I marked it as "exception: no VAT" in the record. If accounting needs anything else we'll ping you.
ella: thanks!"
